_meta.threadlinqs/catalog_note: Served from the public catalog, not your authenticated tool list. Check THREADLINQS_API_KEY.

description: List the most recently published threats. Paginated: pass limit (default 15, max 100) and offset to page through older threats; the result includes has_more and an opaque next_cursor (reusable as offset/cursor).

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor (next_cursor from a prior result). Decoded to an offset; ignored when offset is given.

offset.description: Row offset for pagination (default 0). Or pass cursor from a prior result.

name: get_recent_threats

has_more.description: True when another page may exist.

next_cursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page, or null when this is the last page or the endpoint ignores offset.

total.description: Total matching rows, when the handler reports one.

title: Recent Threats
